profile.summary: Software Engineer | AI & Data Infrastructure & Marketing | Distributed Systems, Real-Time Pipelines, Reliability

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Built the event instrumentation, data pipelines and conversion APIs that tell Instacart's ad partners (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Snap, Microsoft) which campaigns drive orders.
• Drove the engineering behind a cross-functional push to improve conversion signals sent to Meta: server-side conversion volume brought in line with source of truth, with much stronger match-key coverage and Pixel-to-server deduplication.
• Launched Google Tag Gateway, serving Google tags first-party through our CDN, with a phased rollout, kill switch and monitoring.
• Designed and shipped a 365-day reactivation conversion signal to Instacart's ad partners.
• Lead the migration of marketing events to Instacart's new event platform across web, iOS and Android.
• Migrated the team's production marketing data pipelines to a new orchestration platform ahead of deadline.

positions.title: Backend Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Building the next-generation Agentic experience through optimizing LLMs and enhancing next-generation Music models. Built data pipelines for models to streamline low-latency and fresh computational data.
• Updated batch pipelines for Spotify Wrapped 2025 to include yearly listening history and statistics, for a 1 billion+ user release.
• Created Lookr Studio dashboards and BigQuery visualizations for identifying view states for optimization and deprecation, reducing yearly costs by $1M+. Developed internal Web tool for ML engineers to visualize their data-streaming pipelines and events, showing dependencies, metrics, and configurations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Backend and Fullstack Engineer for Market Intelligence, Securities, and Ledger team, developing real-time market data systems for Invest product and financial systems.
• Developed Full-stack internal tool application to enable traders to manually update stock information, corporate actions, and update transactions of Sofi users.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless system integration, scaling, and support
• Architected real-time market data systems for the Invest product, processing 200,000+ events/minute
using Kotlin, Java, AWS and Terraform, enhancing data reliability and scalability.
• Streamlined on-call operations by creating Datadog monitors and runbooks, reducing incident response time
and ensuring production stability for high-traffic financial systems.
• Created large-scale data platform pipelines using GCP, Apache, and Scio. Created data processing frameworks using Apache Spark
• Integrated data providers to ingest real-time market data analysis and information via web-sockets and
workflows. (PostgresSQL, Redis, Kotlin/Java, OpenAPI, Kafka, Temporal, Kubernetes)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Friend Interactions backend engineer developing new high-priority consumption and creation experiences
• Researched and developed Story Avatar Circle to introduce Stories on Tiktok and increase consumption
by over 100%.
• Implemented new Skylight feature to show users’ stories in feeds and unblock filtered collection content.
• Optimized services improving latency, metrics, and outage detection infrastructure. Drastically increased Story consumption and creation services by +10% launching feature experiments in Go, Python, Redis, AWS, and Grafana.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Developed an automated load-testing tool in Python to synthetically stress test load on several services to
detect patterns to prevent 1,000+ large scale outages on AWS clusters.
• Added MongoDB support on queries for aggregation and randomization tests to replicate user load.
Researched breaking points of clusters to optimize bottlenecks of jobs and increase capacity limits of services
